label: HCP-LAN APM categories
disclaimer: Classification framework and national payment mix; not contract terms. The 2017 refresh white paper URL now returns 404; categories are taken from the LAN fact sheet.

value.1: Fee for service, no link to quality or value
value.2A: Foundational payments for infrastructure and operations
value.3A: APMs with shared savings (upside risk only)
value.3B: APMs with shared savings and downside risk
value.3N: Risk-based payments not linked to quality
value.4B: Comprehensive population-based payment (global budget or % of premium)
value.4N: Capitated payments not linked to quality

ma_payments_lan_3_4.unit: share of Medicare Advantage payments in categories 3-4, CY2023
